data.one_liner: A drag gesture detector that handles overscrolling ScrollViews inside of it.
data.what_it_does: Scroll Drag Detector is a specialized version of GestureDetector designed to pick up overscrolling ScrollViews placed inside of it. It helps developers easily create draggable scrollable sheets in Flutter by handling interactions between dragging and scrolling.
use_when: You need to build draggable scrollable sheets in Flutter.
You need a gesture detector that can handle overscrolling scroll views within it.
avoid_when: You only need standard gesture detection without scroll views.
You do not need physics-based sheet dragging interactions.
strengths: Unlocks easy draggable scrollable sheets in Flutter.
Handles interactions between dragging and scrolling smoothly with callbacks.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic usage and changelog history.
Niche use case focused specifically on overscrolling scroll views.
